mentions.name: Entropy Loop
mentions.description: Open source quantum random number generator (QRNG) developed with Quantum Village in donated lab space at a London university. Current work focuses on making the device faster and increasing its entropy output.
mentions.source_excerpt: Open source quantum hardware with Quantum Village in donated lab space at a London university. Pushing the boundary for Entropy Loop, a QRNG to make it faster and more enteopy, and the Uncut Gem redesign, our NVC diamond based quantum magnetometer.
mentions.author: unprovable
